verdicts.reason: A leaves a large dead band across the top while the CTA, logo pill and can are pushed down against the bottom edge, so the bottom row looks cramped. Its CTA is also tiny next to the headline. B centres the text block vertically, keeps margins even and leaves room under the action row, but it shares the same flaws: the 'Top Up Now' button is undersized, the can is shrunk to a thumbnail and crammed in beside the logo pill, and the upscaled controller has jagged, pixelated edges.
